defects.description: Section headers are not translated into Russian.
The term 'Risk Threshold Breach' is translated as 'Нарушение порога риска' instead of the required 'Превышение порога риска'.
The term 'finding' is translated as 'заключение' instead of the required 'Вывод'.
The term 'subject' is translated as 'субъект' instead of the required 'Объект обсуждения'.
The term 'high-severity finding' is translated as 'высокоуровневое заключение', which fails to use the required equivalents for both 'Severity' (Уровень серьёзности) and 'Finding' (Вывод).
